title: Beta traffic gating, KPI playbook & capacity sandbox
content:
PURPOSE:
Short: operational playbook for moving a small-batch beta from gated traffic to broad beta while protecting latency/cost/quality SLOs. This is a living sheet: use it to simulate ramps in the capacity sandbox, record KPI baselines, and carry out the preflight checklist before each step.

QUICK SUMMARY: 
- Owner: Priya Raman (product-ops lead)
- Runbook point: Redwood Console > Rollouts > Beta-traffic-sandbox (placeholder)
- Scope: Beta cohort (invite-only) -> Public beta (gradual)
- Primary KPIs: p50/p95 server-side latency, end-to-end latency, per-request cost, model-quality accept rate, 5xx error rate, KV-cache hit rate, throughput (requests/s)

KPI DEFINITIONS & TARGETS (baselines to capture in sandbox):
- p50_latency_ms: median server-side token generation time; target <= 120 ms for beta-1; alert at > 200 ms
- p95_latency_ms: 95th percentile; target <= 450 ms; gate if > 700 ms for 10m window
- end_to_end_ms: client->response; target <= 800 ms
- error_rate_5xx_pct: proportion of requests returning 5xx; gate if > 0.5% sustained 5m
- cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: observed per-1k-token unit cost in Sandbox; alert if > 1.3x forecasted
- model_quality_accept_rate_pct: percentage of outputs that pass automated QA heuristics (~golden prompt set); gate if < 92%
- kv_cache_hit_rate_pct: target >= 60% for prefix-heavy workloads
- throughput_rps: system throughput observed; must sustain planned burst + 30% buffer

MEASUREMENT WINDOWS & DASHBOARDS:
- Primary dashboards: Redwood Console -> Per-route latency + token-cost, and /metrics ingestion to Datadog: prodops.beta.kpis.*
- Measurement windows: immediate (5m), short (30m), medium (6h), comparative (24h)
- Canary logging: enable streaming for first 10k tokens per host for manual QA sampling

TRAFFIC GATING MATRIX (RAMP PLAN):
Columns: Phase | % of target users | QPS cap (global) | Max concurrent sessions | Fallback model | Canary hosts | Gate trigger
- phase: private-alpha | pct: 1% | qps: 5 | conc: 20 | fallback: n/a | canary: 2 hosts | gate: manual
- phase: invited-beta | pct: 5% | qps: 25 | conc: 100 | fallback: smaller-quantized-model | canary: 4 hosts | gate: auto on KPI breach
- phase: staged-beta | pct: 20% | qps: 120 | conc: 450 | fallback: smaller-quantized-model + lower-context variant | canary: 10 hosts | gate: auto
- phase: broad-beta | pct: 100% | qps: target | conc: full | fallback: cross-region fallback + queued requests | canary: 20 hosts | gate: auto + human review

GATING RULES (examples):
- If p95_latency > 700 ms for 10m OR error_rate_5xx_pct > 0.5% for 5m -> pause ramp and rollback to previous traffic allocation; page ENG-SRE + serving-runtime lead.
- If model_quality_accept_rate_pct < 92% over the golden prompt set sampled every 30m -> hold ramp and trigger model-eval workflow.
- If cost_per_1k_tokens_usd > forecast*1.3 for 6h -> throttle non-critical traffic (batch jobs), reduce context window for non-essential routes.

CAPACITY SANDBOX CONFIG (for preflight simulations):
- Test cluster topology: 4x A100-like GPUs (baseline), 8x for stress; configure autoscaler min=2 nodes, max=12 nodes.
- Synthetic traffic generator: ramp script repo at github.com/redwood-inference/ramp-scripts (use /scenarios/beta_smallbursts.yaml).
- Pre-warm key artifacts: KV-cache priming with top 50k prefixes, warm model weights cache on GPUs 20m before ramp.
- Autoscale triggers: CPU/GPU saturation > 85% for 3m, token-queue length > 1000 for 2m.
- Pre-provision buffer: reserve 15% extra capacity for first 24h of each larger ramp.

ROLL-OUT SCHEDULE TEMPLATE (example timeline for invited-beta -> staged-beta):
- Day -3: Dry run in sandbox; run smoke + golden-prompt QA; capture KPIs for 24h. Owners: QA (Claire), SRE (Owen).
- Day -1: Stakeholder sync (product, SRE, serving-runtime, growth). Confirm rollback anchors.
- T0 (hour 0): Enable 5% traffic (invited). Monitor 0-30m for immediate failures.
- T+2h: If stable, increase to 10%. T+6h: 20%. T+24h: decision point to move to staged-beta (20%->50% over 6h if KPIs OK).
- Ramp increments: prefer step multipliers no greater than 2x per 2h window.

PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST (checkboxes style for each rollout step):
- [ ] Golden prompt validation suite run (link: confluence://prodops/golden-prompts) — owner: Claire Donovan — JIRA: JIRA-PRODOPS-642
- [ ] Capacity sandbox runbook executed (scripts & results attached) — owner: Owen Lee — JIRA: JIRA-SRE-210
- [ ] Autoscaler policy and pre-warm confirmed — owner: Ethan Chen
- [ ] Rollback artifacts prepared (previous model version, routing policy) — owner: Serving Runtime
- [ ] Alerts defined and pages set (Datadog alerts + PagerDuty) — owner: SRE oncall
- [ ] Customer communication draft for invitees — owner: Growth
- [ ] Compliance/PII review done for sample logs retention — owner: Security & Compliance

CONTINGENCY HANDLES & ROLLBACK STEPS:
1) Pause new traffic allocations (product-ops console toggle)
2) Shift all traffic to fallback model variant (quantized or lower-context) via routing policy; monitor improvement for 15m
3) If no improvement: rollback to previous deployment snapshot and revert routing flags; abort further ramps until postmortem
4) Post-incident: collect perf traces (tracing link placeholder) and schedule immediate incident review within 24h.
Owners: primary=Owen Lee (SRE), secondary=Ethan Chen (serving-runtime).

SIMULATION MATRIX (must run in sandbox prior to each ramp):
- Scenario A: steady 20% of expected beta peak for 6h -> verify sustained KPIs
- Scenario B: burst 5x baseline for 10m -> check autoscale reaction and cold-start tail latencies
- Scenario C: KV-cache cold start (drop cache) -> measure p95 impact and queue lengths
- Scenario D: degraded model quality (inject noisy responses) -> validate detection via golden prompts

NOTES TO RUNNERS & UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS:
- Note: sample-percent uses adaptive random seeding tied to user cohort IDs to avoid correlated samples.
- Q: Should we apply token-cap on non-authenticated requests at staged-beta? (decision pending; flagged in meeting notes)
- Q: Post-ramp cost amortization strategy between product and infra billing (ask finance)

ATTACHMENTS & REFERENCES (links to artifacts):
- Sandbox results folder: confluence://prodops/sandbox-results-beta-2025-06
- Ramp scripts: github.com/redwood-inference/ramp-scripts/tree/main/scenarios
- Rollout console guide: confluence://prodops/rollout-console-guide

LAST UPDATED NOTES: 2025-07-03 — moved autoscale min -> 2 to improve cost profile after dry run.
